faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the CSIR NEERI Project Associate-II recruitment?
faq.answer: The last date to submit your online application for the Project Associate-II position at CSIR NEERI is 03 September 2026. Ensure all details are accurate before the deadline.

faq.question: Q2. What are the minimum qualifications required for the Project Associate-II post?
faq.answer: Candidates need a B.E./B.Tech in Civil, Computer Science, or Environmental Engineering with 2 years of experience, or an M.Sc. in Environment Science or Life Science with 2 years of experience, or an M.E./M.Tech in Civil, Environmental Engg, or Electronics & Telecommunication Engineering.

faq.question: Q3. Is there any application fee for this recruitment?
faq.answer: No, according to the provided information, there is no application fee for General/OBC and SC/ST categories for this recruitment drive.

faq.question: Q4. What is the maximum age limit for the Project Associate-II position?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for candidates applying for the Project Associate-II post is 35 years.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary offered for the Project Associate-II role?
faq.answer: The selected candidate will receive a monthly salary ranging from Rs. 28,000/- to Rs. 35,000/- plus HRA.

faq.question: Q6. How will candidates be selected for the Project Associate-II position?
faq.answer: The selection process for the Project Associate-II position will be based on an Online Interview.

faq.question: Q7. What is the job type for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The job offered is on a contractual basis for the Project Associate-II position at CSIR NEERI.

faq.question: Q8. Which organization is conducting this recruitment?
faq.answer: This recruitment is being conducted by CSIR-National Environmental Engineering Research Institute (CSIR NEERI).

faq.question: Q9. In which city and state is the CSIR NEERI located?
faq.answer: CSIR NEERI is located in Nagpur, Maharashtra, with the pincode 440020.

faq.question: Q10. Where can I find the official notification and apply online?
faq.answer: You can find the official notification and the apply online link in the "Important Links" section of this article. The official website is also provided.
